description: Phantom Movies v1.5.9 promotes the account/profile update to stable. Users can sign in with email or Google, skip login when they want, sync profile/settings/watch history data through Firebase, use the cleaned-up onboarding screen, and switch the account card between Login and Logout based on auth state.
body: Phantom Movies v1.5.9 promotes the account/profile update to stable.
